feature: Observed real-task effectiveness comparison of project experience versions

behavior.entry: 任务复盘 → 候选优化与发布 → 真实任务版本效果对比
behavior.ownership: Read-only headless projection of the existing project journal; shell renders validated projections and emits typed navigation/query intents.
behavior.attribution: A task-turn binding is appended after durable session/project ownership is established, retaining the existing AgentTurnConfigV2. Context commit cites the exact experience context artifact only after a matching provider-started turn. Retained same-session advice remains attributed even when omitted from the current envelope by its byte budget.
behavior.cohorts: Published release, unpublished library revision, or explicitly no advice; separated by backend, model, reasoning effort, output limit and prompt profile digest. Cross-release, advice/no-advice mixed, cross-model/config, stale/nonterminal or incomplete evidence is excluded and explained.
behavior.metrics: Task status completion rate, failed/blocked/cancelled counts, tool calls/failure rate, repeated failures, repairs, elapsed time including waits, final input/output token means with their own known-sample denominator, and environmental-diagnostic counts.
behavior.history: Latest review per task, complete retained history scan with bounded query windows, 20 sample rows per page, sequence-bound cursor. Immutable source references remain in .aistudio/agent and reconstruct after restart.
behavior.interaction: Lazy collapsed panel, baseline/comparison selectors, original task-review navigation, refresh and sample pagination; cancellation/generation guards prevent delayed responses after project switch/disposal.
limitations: Observational task mix, not controlled A/B or proof that advice caused an improvement.
Old tasks without reliable actual-turn attribution remain excluded, not inferred from publication time.
Prepared context is not proof that the model followed advice; no automatic ranking, publication or paid model task execution.
No cost conversion or imputed missing token values.
behavior.validationFixtures: Synthetic deterministic tasks and isolated Electron project fixtures test implementation; they are not presented as measured production-game quality.

secretScan.limitation: Pattern and configured-value scan of generated files; no real credential store is read. A zero crash-dump count means no dump was generated.

transientFailure.detail: First capability capture failed an existing native/replayed camera assertion. No assertion or product code was changed for it. Standalone rerun and subsequent full capability capture passed.
